sources.title: Enhanced Cricket Commentary Using AI Vision and Multilingual ...
sources.snippet: This paper presents a novel approach to generating cricket commentary using AI vision and multilingual support. The system utilizes GPT-4 Vision to process short, audio-free cricket videos as input, analyzing frames in video to create detailed visual descriptions of the ongoing action. sources.snippet: This approach allows us to provide numerous examples to the model during fine-tuning, helping it learn to consistently extract and structure information from cricket commentaries.
